authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9051 phala gives regional phal fruit and Oriya phara, with p-initial reflexes elsewhere. Bhatri pəl/pʌl is compared with this fruit family; loss of aspiration is retained as a regional comparative qualification. Exact survey form pəl is preserved.
